Input image 2 is the AUTHORITATIVE ART STYLE reference: homescreen save panel. Match image 2 closely: rich dark horizontal wooden planks, slim warm brass edging, chunky shaped brass corner brackets with round rivets, ivory elegant regular serif lettering, restrained warm selected outlines. No grey stone or silver framing. All geometry orthographic front-facing, no perspective, no stretching, all controls properly proportioned and with consistent sizing and spacing. Render a centered complete settings panel with all four edges visible, surrounded by some subdued blue and amber cave background from reference 2. No homescreen menu behind it. Title Einstellungen integrated on wood, no huge separate title plaque. Only necessary German UI labels, no explanatory copy, no annotations, no variant label, no watermark. Show the Tastenbelegung page. Compact wooden key-binding buttons with brass endcaps, comfortable height, short appropriate width; no excessively stretched long strips. Align rows precisely. Footer Standard at left, Fortsetzen at right. Keep ivory text readable and centered within controls, balanced visual hierarchy. VARIANT 1: faithful evolution of homescreen save panel. Wide centered panel about 78% of screen width. Three evenly spaced horizontal tab buttons below title: Audio, Tastenbelegung (selected subtle golden outline), Anzeige. The table sits below with a wide action column and two compact key columns, fine unobtrusive brass horizontal separators, generous symmetric interior margins. Outer wood-and-brass frame closely resembles reference 2, proportional trim width. Dark wood directly behind rows, no heavy zebra striping. Calm polished cohesive composition.
